screen.rationale: Primary study, but PS microplastic photodegradation was run only under a 365 nm (λmax) 8 W UVA lamp; the Xe lamp was used only for bacterial inactivation. Outcomes would also fail E5: only FTIR carbonyl/peroxyl index changes, TOC mineralization (~20% / ~8%, figure) and qualitative NMR (SI).
screen.evidence_loc: Materials and Methods > Photoinduced Degradation Experiments ¶1

excluded_observations.why: UV-only light (E3); carbonyl/peroxyl index is not an E5 endpoint.
UV-only light; mineralization/TOC is not an E5 endpoint; values in figure.
